research_question: Does replacing the secret-dependent Cornacchia Euclidean loop by a fixed 1421-round branch/address schedule remove coarse iteration leakage without leaving exploitable operand-, mask-, or state-dependent power/EM leakage?

literature_anchor.timing_and_control_flow: Ready to SQI? Safety First!, IACR ePrint 2023/807
literature_anchor.power_attack_context: Simple Power Analysis Attack on SQIsign, IACR ePrint 2025/830, AFRICACRYPT 2025
literature_anchor.interpretation: The fixed half-GCD directly targets the Euclidean control-flow surface discussed in timing work. The power paper demonstrates why regular control flow alone is not a resistance proof.

candidate.measured_window: one interrupt-masked call to the fixed half-GCD adapter; public root/reference setup and serial I/O are outside
unprotected_properties: data-dependent arithmetic masks and switching activity
no operand blinding or randomized projective representation
no power or EM measurement yet
full signer retains other variable-time and retry surfaces

already_observed.interpretation: The matched variable-Euclid firmware resolves the public 95-versus-122-step class by about 1476.9 us, while the fixed 1421-round firmware resolves no H/L difference at 1-us timer resolution. This validates the coarse timer positive control and the removal of iteration-count timing at this granularity; it is not an equivalence test, an analog positive control, or a side-channel-resistance result.

campaigns.purpose: instrument, trigger, clipping, alignment, and negative-control calibration
classes: B: the identical fixture 0 repeated with an independently balanced label
campaigns.acceptance: stable trigger/alignment and no reproducible class separation in two independently acquired sessions
campaigns.inconclusive: clipping, trigger ambiguity, clock drift, label/order imbalance, or positive same-input control

completed_coarse_timer_artifact.result: legacy H-L mean +1476.8667 us with approximate 95% CI [1474.9005, 1478.8328] us; fixed H-L mean +0.2 us with approximate 95% CI [-0.5303, 0.9303] us

campaigns.required_analog_artifact: Acquire the matched legacy variable-Euclid firmware with the same shunt/current or EM setup, GPIO wrapper, clock, compiler and serial exclusion used for the protected firmware.
classes: L: fixture 4, observed legacy Euclid count 95
H: fixture 7, observed legacy Euclid count 122
campaigns.acceptance: the analog setup resolves the known variable-control difference before protected-firmware non-detection is interpreted
campaigns.warning: The coarse timer positive control has passed, but it does not validate power/EM sensitivity. Absence of an analog positive control makes protected analog non-detection inconclusive.

campaigns.purpose: fixed-versus-varying leakage assessment of the protected component
classes: R: balanced cycle over public fixtures 1 through 15
campaigns.schedule: balanced AB/BA order with independent random permutation; repeat as a second session after reacquisition and realignment
analysis: same-input A/B control analyzed with the identical pipeline
preprocessing sensitivity report with raw unfiltered data retained
campaigns.exploratory_threshold: absolute t below 4.5 in both protected sessions and both corresponding same-input controls
campaigns.warning: TVLA-style non-detection is not proof against SPA, profiling, DPA, horizontal attacks, or key recovery

preregistration_before_traces: extend the public-fixture profiler to emit the 1421 per-round update/mask labels
freeze segmentation, features, classifier, train/test split, trace budgets, and failure handling
keep labels and ground truth outside production firmware
evaluation: per-round mask accuracy and Hamming distance
campaigns.failure: any reproducible recovery materially above the preregistered control/null distribution
campaigns.warning: public-fixture classification is a component leakage result, not signing-key recovery

channels: shunt power or calibrated current probe
metadata: probe and acquisition-instrument model, serial, settings, and calibration
target voltage, 150-MHz clock, compiler, SDK, interrupt policy
raw unfiltered traces, labels, acquisition order, and lossless instrument-native archive
all exclusions, dropped traces, alignment failures, and reruns

decision_rule.fail: reproducible leakage or classifier success in the protected firmware, or any exact/partial secret-derived decision recovery beyond the frozen null distribution
decision_rule.bounded_empirical_pass: positive and negative controls behave as preregistered, no protected-firmware detection or attack succeeds in two independent sessions, and all raw artifacts are archived
decision_rule.inconclusive: failed controls, one session only, insufficient traces, unstable acquisition, missing provenance, or analysis selected after viewing protected traces
decision_rule.claim_boundary_after_pass: component-level bounded empirical evidence only; not constant power, not whole-Sign resistance, and not certification
